title: Empty battlefield control cleanup
new_text: Players lose control of any controlled Battlefields without their Units occupying them if the turn is in an open state and there is no Showdown or Combat ongoing there.
explanation: Rule 323.6 is corrected to agree with 187.4.c: an empty battlefield does not lose its controller during a closed state or while a Showdown or Combat is ongoing there.
